title: Sales Report CSV Export

requirements.text: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page that initiates a download of the current report
Add a backend endpoint that streams the generated CSV so memory usage stays bounded for large reports
Allow the user to select which columns to include, exporting only selected columns in displayed order
Encode the CSV per RFC 4180, quoting and escaping fields with commas, quotes, or newlines
Include a header row with human-readable column names for the selected columns

hallucination_traps: No XLSX or PDF export format is mentioned
No scheduled or emailed export is mentioned
notes: A faithful decomposition covers the UI button, streaming endpoint, column selection, and RFC 4180 escaping; must not invent XLSX/PDF output.
